pages.text: $(li)$(item)Timer$(): ticks while B is off, pulsing front, left and right $(li)$(item)Sequencer$(): signal walks front, right, back, left $(li)$(item)State Cell$(): a pulse on B starts a countdown, the right side (or left, set in the window) is on meanwhile, then the front pulses
$(li)$(item)Counter$(): L +1, R -1; front on at maximum, back on at zero; comparators read the count
Right-click these gates to open the $(l)settings window$(): time in seconds (0.2 s to 1 h) or the counter maximum (1-1024). They make a quiet tick sound, which can be muted per gate in the window.
